question: Will the English Wikipedia have at least 7,145,000 articles before March 1, 2026?
summary: Adversarial objections describe possible near-term upticks (one-day surge, anniversary campaigns) that could push the count higher, but the arithmetic suggests such a crossing would require an implausibly large spike in a single day.
Observed counts as of Feb 28, 2026 place English Wikipedia at 7,143,993, leaving about 1,007 short of 7,145,000; historical growth rates are tens of thousands per year, not thousands per day.
Given the above, we assign a very low but nonzero probability (~2%), reflecting residual uncertainty from potential unusual editor activity.
